title: Repository checks
what: The checks that read the tree: dependencies, manifests, layout, version, the testbed declaration, Hangul, and the names list held outside the checkout. The personal-data check stands in its own node.

title: Personal-data rule and its check
what: The repository prohibition of personal data, the values it allows, and the check that reads every tracked file for a mail address, a home path, a telephone number, a token and a private network address, in docs/PERSONAL-DATA.md and tests/personal_data.rs.
